updates.body: We’re currently seeing elevated error rates and response times with some Cartes Bancaires payments due to an issuer-side degradation starting 07:23 UTC June 4th. We believe this outage is outside of Stripe's infrastructure. This is likely impacting a number of payment processors. We’re continuing to monitor and will post further updates.
